summary: The @barkpark/bulldocs-sdk is a thin TypeScript authoring SDK for the Bulldocs plugin — it provides typed block constructors, patch-op constructors, a Paper builder, and an HTTP client to publish/mutate papers against the Barkpark ingest API.

intentions.title: Provide a type-safe authoring surface for PortableDoc content
intentions.evidence: blocks.ts defines the full Block union (15+ types) with constructors whose field names are explicitly pinned to what compose_block/2 reads in the Elixir renderer — preventing wire-format drift by design

intentions.title: Enable programmatic paper creation and atomic batch mutation
intentions.evidence: paper.ts gives a chainable Paper builder; ops.ts defines the full Op union (append/insert/patch/replace/remove/move); client.ts submitOps sends all ops in one atomic request with optional optimistic-concurrency guard (ifRev)

intentions.title: Keep the SDK wire-format contract honest against the server
intentions.evidence: Both blocks.ts and ops.ts carry explicit comments cross-referencing the exact Elixir module and key names they mirror (compose_block/2, patch.ex, BulldocsIngestController.apply_op/2) — the field names are described as 'not invented'

intentions.title: Support deterministic, byte-reproducible output for tests
intentions.evidence: blocks.ts uses a monotonic counter for block ids instead of Date.now()/random, and exports resetBlockIds() so test suites can get reproducible byte output

intentions.title: Isolate HTTP concerns behind a mockable boundary
intentions.evidence: BulldocsClient accepts an injectable fetch implementation in its constructor options, decoupling the client from the global fetch for test/mock server scenarios
